system.description: This is an axe attack that relies on your axe's “beard” (the portion of the blade directly below the axe's cutting edge) to hook a target's weapon or shield. A successful attack deals 2 less damage than normal but causes them to drop one or the other. To retrieve their weapon or shield, the target must use an action. Alternatively, you can hook a limb to pull your target off balance. This attack deals 1 less damage than normal but hinders your target's tasks until your next turn. Action.
